name: has_onion_rings_variant
description: Detects products that contain 'onion rings' or 'onion ring' in either name or description, including variants like 'onion ring chips' or 'onion rings flavour', to capture a broad range of onion-based fried products.

name: has_sweet_potato_base
description: Identifies products where 'sweet potato' is present in the description or name, indicating a specific vegetable base that distinguishes them from other fried vegetable products.

name: has_tempura_fry_method
description: Flags products that mention 'tempura' in either side, indicating a distinct frying method (e.g., vegetable tempura), which differentiates from deep-fried or breaded products.

name: is_fried_green_vegetable
description: Detects products involving green vegetables (e.g., green beans, green tomatoes) that are fried, distinguishing them from other types of fried vegetables.

name: is_frozen_product
description: Flags products that are explicitly described as frozen, which is common in fast-food or pre-processed breaded vegetable items.

name: has_breaded_vegetable_tag
description: Categorizes products based on whether they are tagged as breaded vegetables in Open Food Facts, which is a strong indicator of product type.
